items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: He had a party at his house and Alvin Batiste... His wife and Alvin, they came up from Atlanta.

ctx.x: What was he like as a person for you?

Very natural. Just like you know, just like on all the records when he talked and did his introductions and all that kind of stuff, he was just sort of like that. Very open. A very © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
